accessibility.names: Named toolbar/fields and full occurrence Name/HelpText in MermaidEditorStyles.xaml; per-family automation prefixes.
accessibility.limitations: No blanket claim that every control has a unique AutomationId/HelpText. UIA is not a screen-reader session.

focus.description: Shared FocusSelectedRow/DeferNavigation and native field focus. Existing UIA covers selected-row focus and owner Undo/Redo; exhaustive Tab/Shift+Tab and caret recovery require manual protocol.

inspectorSelection.description: Persistent inspector; pending property selection rejected; exact source identities; ambiguous/unrendered occurrences retain list/source access.

viewport.description: Native canonical drawing, zoom, middle-mouse pan and Fit; no invented replacement layout.

applyCancelHistory.description: Private history and guarded owner/source/version Apply as one owner Undo action; Cancel preserves owner; stale-owner rejection preserves drafts.

sourceValidation.description: Invalid pending fields/source preserved; actionable diagnostic and Apply disabled; untouched LF/CRLF/Unicode retained.

scroll.description: Adjustable source and independent inspector; existing resize/navigation assertions are narrower than exhaustive caret/selection/scroll combinations.

installed.status: BASELINE WORKFLOW SUCCESS; raw phase receipts reconciled separately
